gloss: rise and fall; prosperity and decline

definitions.gloss: rise and fall; prosperity and decline
definitions.explanation: The natural cycle of flourishing and declining over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛衰|せいすい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ともに→共に：03468_tomoni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The rise and fall of companies changes with the times.
Rise and fall is the way of the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛衰|せいすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}する→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧。
examples.english: To research the rise and decline of cultures.

notes:
{盛衰|せいすい} means rise and fall or the cycle of prosperity and decline.

WRITING:
- {盛|せい}: flourishing, prosperous
- {衰|すい}: decline, wane

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {盛衰|せいすい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：noentry⟧: rise and fall is the way of the world
- ⟦{栄枯|えいこ}→栄枯：08133_eiko⟧{盛衰|せいすい}: the vicissitudes of life (flourishing and withering)

USAGE:
Often used for discussing historical events, empires, companies, or civilizations over time.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{興亡|こうぼう}→興亡：05568_koubou⟧: rise and fall (often for nations/empires)
- ⟦{浮沈|ふちん}→浮沈：08128_fuchin⟧: ups and downs
- ⟦{栄枯|えいこ}→栄枯：08133_eiko⟧: prosperity and decline
